jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**As Senior CRM Associate, Lifecycle & Loyalty, you build, scale and optimise the automated lifecycle journeys and the loyalty and promotion mechanics that turn app users into repeat customers across all our markets. You will work across two pillars that function as one system: lifecycle in Braze, and loyalty and short-term incentives in Talon.One. Underneath both sits consumer data, which you use with Amplitude and SQL to decide who to talk to, what to offer and what to do next. You will sit in the CRM & Promotions team within Digital Marketing at our Copenhagen HQ and report to the Head of CRM & Promotional Loyalty.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own and optimise lifecycle journeys in Braze across activation, engagement, retention, win-back and loyalty, with the incentive built in

• Run a structured test-and-learn programme with A/B and multivariate tests, holdouts and incremental lift, including the cost of the incentive

• Set up, QA and deploy loyalty rules, rewards and short-term promotions in Talon.One, and make Talon.One and Braze work as one connected system

• Measure journey, cohort and promotion performance, validate that measurement can be trusted, and investigate data discrepancies between tools

• Write SQL, and build and maintain Amplitude dashboards that the team and stakeholders actually use

• Act as the CRM point of contact for markets, franchise partners and global teams, prioritise requests by impact and push back with data when needed

• Design reusable Canvas structures, Content Blocks, Liquid logic and catalogs so one build serves many markets and segments

• Run one-off campaigns from templates, turn repeated requests into automation, and build playbooks so markets can self-serve the basics

• QA and coach junior colleagues, keep a QA checklist for every launch, and document how journeys and promotions work

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A critical thinker who questions assumptions, finds root causes and separates correlation from causation

• A strong stakeholder manager who can negotiate scope and timelines and present results, including negative or inconclusive ones, to senior and non-technical audiences

• Impact-driven, and you prioritise bigger wins over marginal gains

• Independent on briefs, and happy to share knowledge and coach junior colleagues

• Quality-first, with clear communication across markets and cultures

• Someone who spots repeating manual work and replaces it with automation

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5-7 years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, with at least 3-4 years hands-on in Braze

• Deep Braze skills: Canvas Flow, Liquid, Connected Content, Content Blocks, catalogs, event and API-triggered journeys, segmentation, A/B and holdout testing

• Hands-on Talon.One experience: rules, rewards, audiences and QA

• Experience designing loyalty and short-term incentive mechanics and measuring their impact, including cost and incrementality

• Hands-on Amplitude experience, building dashboards and charts and using them to find insight

• Light SQL knowledge (joins, filters, aggregations) and working knowledge of APIs, JSON and webhooks

• Understanding of events, attributes, Currents and SDK basics, how they feed the warehouse, plus Branch and deep linking

• A track record of building templated, scalable journeys across several markets or journey stages

• Fluent English

• Nice to have: Braze certification, experimentation design and statistical significance, and multi-market CRM or app-based loyalty experience with sound judgement on incentives

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Rather than hiring for one narrow profile, we are opening multiple positions for implementation specialists across the full front-to-back platform, and we will match you to the projects where your depth is strongest.

The team allows for consulting excellency, efficiency in configuration and standardization as well as knowledge sharing and collaboration across divisions and market units. As a Lead Business Consultant you are, or will become, a trusted business and technology advisor for our clients in one or more of the following areas:

• Investment operations, settlement and post-trade processing

• Data management, interfaces and communications (Data & Com)

• Compliance, regulatory and internal restrictions

• Risk management (market and liquidity)

• Alternative investments and private markets

• Instrument valuation and analytics (theoretical pricing)

You will be exposed to the complete spectrum of financial instruments and their valuation, from plain vanilla equity and fixed income instruments to complex OTC derivatives and private market assets. Furthermore, you will work with all processes related to your area of specialization.

As part of your induction you will be ‘hands-on’ in our software system and attend the three-weeks’ SimCorp Dimension® Academy.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Business Consultant you will take over a range of tasks in a project team, such as:

• Design and configure solutions across multiple modules and project streams that enable our clients to reach their desired outcomes

• Connect your specialism to the wider front-to-back solution, working closely with colleagues who cover the adjacent areas of the platform

• Advise on and improve standard implementation processes as well as product and service offerings

• Identify opportunities for growth and explore new ideas, feeding this back to the organisation and supporting its development

• Participate in sales processes when required to position SimCorp concepts and offerings

• Instruct and mentor less experienced colleagues on the job and share knowledge with colleagues on an international level

**What We Value

**You like to deep dive into business processes in investment management and enjoy modelling them in our software. You have in-depth knowledge about the business at asset managers, fund managers, insurers or banks. In addition you bring with you:

• Degree in economics, finance, mathematics, computer science or similar qualification

• Previous experience as an Analyst or (Implementation) Consultant for asset managers, asset owners, banks or consulting firms

• FRM, CFA, CIPM or other relevant certifications/designations are desirable

• Team spirit and a desire to share your knowledge

• High communication and consulting skills

• High degree of commercial awareness, customer orientation and quality consciousness

• Fluency in English

• Readiness to travel

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Azeta GUITI. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a prominent provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide high-quality solutions to our clients

jobs.description:
**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

About the job

GN is entering a new chapter. Following the definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon, this role sits within the Hearing business and offers a unique opportunity to influence the Performance & Reward agenda of a global hearing business at a pivotal point of transition.

Working closely with the Head of Performance & Reward, you will own the pay transparency agenda for the Hearing business while contributing across the broader Performance & Reward agenda. From job architecture and compensation governance to annual reward processes, strategic partnering, and reward philosophy, you will help define how the Hearing business manages performance and reward globally.

The team you will be part of

You will join the Performance & Reward team within HR, working closely with colleagues, business leaders, and stakeholders across the Hearing business to deliver practical, well-governed solutions aligned with business needs. The role offers meaningful ownership, global exposure, and close collaboration across regions and functions, with a real opportunity to help shape the future Performance & Reward operating model.

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Own the pay transparency agenda for the Hearing business, including readiness for and implementation of requirements arising from the EU Pay Transparency Directive across relevant EU markets.

• Partner with HR and business leaders to provide practical, commercially grounded advice across Performance & Reward topics.

• Use pay, workforce, and job architecture data to identify risks, guide decisions, and drive action on pay transparency, pay equity, and broader Reward priorities.

• Shape and deliver core Performance & Reward processes and governance, including performance cycles, job architecture and evaluation, salary structures, and annual compensation cycles.

• Help evolve the Performance & Reward agenda and reward philosophy for the Hearing business, translating business priorities, market insight, and regulatory developments into practical solutions.

What this role offers

This is a visible global role within the Hearing business, with a clear mandate and real room to shape what comes next. With responsibility for a high-profile pay transparency agenda, you will work closely with the Head of Performance & Reward and senior stakeholders globally to evolve reward philosophy, strengthen core practices, and influence the broader Performance & Reward agenda. It is an opportunity for someone who combines strategic thinking with operational rigor and wants to build, not simply operate.

To succeed in the role, we imagine that you bring

You are an experienced Performance & Reward professional, typically with 8+ years of relevant experience in Compensation/Reward, ideally gained in a large international or matrix organization. You combine sound judgment, curiosity, and a practical, collaborative approach, with the ability to navigate complex topics and translate business needs into effective Performance & Reward solutions. You are motivated to take ownership of a core pay transparency agenda while continuing to build breadth across Performance & Reward.

Qualifications

• Experience with pay transparency and a sound understanding of the practical implications of the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

• Experience across core Performance & Reward disciplines; experience with job architecture and Mercer IPE is an advantage.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with Performance & Reward and people data.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to provide practical advice to HR colleagues and business leaders.

• A structured, pragmatic, and proactive approach, with the ability to operate effectively in a changing environment.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 14th. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying. Quick and easy.

We encourage candidates to submit their CV without a photo to support an equal and fair application process.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Join us in this role where you’ll support the Risk & Compliance team by helping manage key governance and compliance processes, analysing data, maintaining documentation, and assisting with reporting. You’ll gain hands-on experience in cyber security and risk management while working closely with specialists across a global organisation.

Welcome to Risk & Compliance

• maintaining and updating documentation, guidelines, procedures, and process materials

• have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and enjoy working with data

• possess excellent communication and teamwork abilities, and can collaborate effectively with different stakeholders

• have experience with Excel, Power BI, or similar tools, and are comfortable working with data and reporting

• have a positive attitude, strong drive, and an eagerness to learn and develop new skills

• thrive in a dynamic environment, take initiative, and have a structured approach to your work.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Qufora develops intuitive medical devices that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life. We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead important product development projects and help strengthen how we plan, collaborate and deliver.

You will take responsibility for the overall delivery of your projects, from defining objectives and establishing realistic plans through development, verification and validation, production readiness and launch.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead cross-functional product development projects, taking accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risks and delivery against agreed business objectives.

• Establish and maintain integrated project plans with clear deliverables, milestones, dependencies, resource needs and decision points.

• Build and lead committed project teams, clarify responsibilities and agree priorities and resource allocation with functional managers.

• At least eight years of relevant project management experience, including substantial experience leading complex, cross-functional product development projects.

What we offer

A role with meaningful responsibility and a direct contribution to products that improve everyday life for their users. You will work closely with skilled colleagues across the business and have the opportunity to influence both project outcomes and how Qufora develops and delivers products.

You will join an organisation where your experience, judgement and initiative can make a visible difference.

**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****What the role is

****We're looking for a Data & Automation Specialist who loves digging into data, and wants to use that foundation to make every team at Onomondo work smarter.

Your starting point is data. You'll work with complex, messy, multi-source data, from billing and revenue to product usage and commercial pipelines and turn it into analysis, dashboards and answers the business can act on. You'll partner with teams across the company (Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations) to understand what they need to know, and build the reporting that gets them there.

From that foundation, you'll look for where the data shows us time being lost, and fix it. That might be a script, an integration, a scheduled job, or an AI skill where that is the right approach. Getting there often means untangling messy data or a half-broken process first and you don't shy away from that groundwork when it's what the job actually needs.

AI is a real and growing part of the toolkit here. As you settle in, there's plenty of room to grow into that area. This includes our AI infrastructure and production agent stack, ready to be taken to the next level. Our vision is a backbone data warehouse with all data sources available so that our colleagues can self-service with trust through AI.

You'll report to our Data Analytics Manager, Jonathan, and be part of the Insights team.

****What you'll do

• Working with complex data across billing, revenue, product usage and commercial systems. Cleaning, modelling and making sense of it

• Building dashboards and visualizations that teams actually use to make decisions. We currently use Tableau for most of our complex visualizations, but we foresee leaning into an in-house setup. Groundwork is already in place to allow for broader adoptions and flexibility

• Running deeper analyses on the questions that matter, from revenue and billing trends to customer behavior and operational efficiency

• Finding the manual, repetitive workflows that cost the company the most time, and automating them in whatever form actually fits

• Building and maintaining integrations between the tools teams already use (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and others)

• Authoring and iterating AI skills where they're the right tool, using Onomondo's existing skill framework

• Growing into deeper AI/agent infrastructure work over time. Connectors, permissioning, production agents and moreNot all at once, of course. We'll start with what matters most, build it to scale, then keep going.

****What we're looking for

• Strong with data: comfortable with SQL, working in a data warehouse (we use BigQuery), and handling complex, imperfect datasets

• Experienced in data visualization and analysis. You can turn a messy question into a clear chart and a clear answer

• Comfortable writing code (Python or similar) to analyse, transform and automate

• A fixer by instinct. You notice friction and want to remove it, without needing to be asked

• Curious about AI, LLMs and agents, and keen to explore how they can make data and processes work better - even if that's not your primary experience yet

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity: nobody will hand you a fully-scoped ticket, you'll often have to find the problem first

• Communicates clearly and works well directly with non-technical stakeholders across teams

Nice to have, though not required: experience with Tableau or similar BI tools, billing or financial data, data modelling, workflow orchestration tools, exposure to LLMs/agents or MCP, or a general understanding of how SaaS businesses run (subscriptions, revenue metrics, GTM tooling, and the cross-team workflows common at software companies).

****Applying

****Your application doesn't need to be polished and you don't need to check all the boxes, to apply.

Tell us what you built, what you were trying to move, and what happened.

****Life at Onomondo

****The things we build have global reach. The way we build them is personal. We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: paid health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with workouts (HIIT of yoga) three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

**That means:

**

• We don’t need your picture

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

**What you can expect:

**

• Screening call with Madalina, our Head of People (Online, 30 minutes)

• Skill interview with Jonathan & Mateusz, our Data Analytics Manager & Head of Revenue Operations (In-Person, 1 hour)

• Meet with our Co-Founder, Michael (In-Person, 30 minutes)

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

Do you want to structure compliance obligations and do you know how to communicate such obligations to an internal organization. Then you might be our new Compliance Manager.

Continia develops add-on solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 20,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 1,800 reselling partners.

At Continia, we are looking for a Compliance Manager who can structure and manage our compliance obligations from both internal policies and legislation. The role is part of our Legal & Compliance team, where you will contribute to ensuring that Continia complies with its obligations and has an appropriate governance structure for it.

Why now?

Continia has been scaling a lot over the last years both in terms of customers, revenue and employees and is now ready to take a more formalized approach to compliance. You will be in the front of that change.

About the role

As Compliance Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with all relevant legal, regulatory, and international standards. You will be responsible for developing and structuring a compliance program that aligns with industry best practices and supports our business objectives.

Continia is ISO27001 certified and we have an ISAE3402 assurance report. You will be responsible for maintaining the certification and assurance report, but not for carrying out all the controls etc. under the frameworks.

This is not an IT Security or data protection expert role. You will have colleagues who are that.

You will work closely with our IT Security employees and your colleagues in Legal & Compliance. You report to Brian Jürs, Head of Legal & Compliance.

You will know you are succeeding when the day-to-day compliance runs smoothly and when your colleagues know what is expected of them and when.

What you will be doing

• Develop, implement, and maintain Continia’s information security and compliance program.

jobs.occupation: 3 Postdoc positions within forest microbiome assisted afforestation

jobs.description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management and Department of Biology, invites applicants for three two-year Postdoc positions within forest microbiome manipulation. The positions are part of the project “MycoForest - Stimulating Forest carbon uptake and storage by mycorrhizal inoculation”, which is financed under the Innomission partnership INNO-CCUS by Innovation Fund Denmark.
 
 Start date is 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.
 
 The project
 The soil microbiome plays a crucial role in soil- and ecosystem functioning including ecosystem carbon sequestration and support of plant nutrient acquisition.
 
 Denmark is devoted to become carbon neutral by 2045/2050, a goal involving a significant role for biological carbon sequestration and storage. A part of the Danish strategy to reach carbon neutrality is to afforest former agricultural land thereby increasing biological ecosystem carbon capture and storage. However, agricultural soils do not harbor an optimal microbiome for initial tree growth and forest ecosystem development. This may lead to increased mortality, reduced tree growth and slower development of forest soil functions and ultimately non-optimal carbon capture, especially in the early stages of afforestation.
 
 Therefore, the MycoForest project aims to manipulate and assist the microbiome of agricultural soils through mycorrhizal inoculation as an integrated part of tree planting to stimulate tree growth and carbon sequestration. Therefore, MycoForest at University of Copenhagen is hiring three postdocs to become part of this novel journey towards increased biological carbon sequestration and to play key roles in the scientific investigations.
 
 Each of the three postdocs will cover one of three distinct areas of fundamental importance to understand and document the role of the microbiome in afforestation.
 
 The three key areas are:

   	
• Microbial and mycorrhizal fungal development 	
• Soil functioning and soil carbon dynamics 	
• Tree survival and growth, and carbon uptake   
 The studies will involve controlled greenhouse as well as field scale experiments, and the three postdocs will each be responsible for one of the three specific parts of the project. At the same time, they will be closely linked to each other through tight collaboration on establishment and sampling of the afforestation experiment. The postdoc positions will start as soon as possible and will run for 2 years. For the requirements of the specific postdocs, please see the descriptions below.
 
 Contact: Specific questions for each of the postdocs, please see below. For general MycoForest questions, please contact Claus Beier, cbe@ign.ku.dk.
 
 Postdoc 1 – Soil microbial development after mycorrhizal inoculation
 The post doc will oversee the formulation and addition of fungal or other types of inoculums and will follow and quantify the mycorrhizal fungal colonization of seedlings, root and soil. Experimentation will be both in mesocosm/greenhouse conditions and in the field. Colonization will be followed in different soils and host trees with a combination of classical microscopic techniques and novel molecular methods. The studies aim to document successful establishment of mycorrhizal fungi within the indigenous communities.
 
 Therefore, we are looking for candidates with specific knowledge and hands-on with:

   	
• Fungi in general including mycorrhizal fungi, preferentially ectomycorrhiza 	
• Field experience in general, handling and sorting soils and roots in specific 	
• Microscopy, especially stereo microscopy of roots 	
• DNA extraction og plants and soil and PCR optimizations including qPCR 	
• Bioinformatics and statistical analysis of meta-barcoding datasets   
 The post doc will work closely together with PD 2 and 3 for plant and soil responses to inoculations.
 
 Principal supervisor is Associate Professor Rasmus Kjøller, Department of Biology, rasmusk@bio.ku.dk, Phone: +45 35322311
 
 Postdoc 2 – Soil functioning and soil carbon dynamics in response to mycorrhizal inoculation
 The post doc will study effects of inoculation in different soil types and tree species on soil carbon processes including formation of persistent SOC fractions.  The postdoc will study soil carbon dynamics in mesocosm/greenhouse conditions in close cooperation with postdoc 1 and in field experimental conditions in cooperation with postdoc 3. The project will address how inoculation and changes in the mycorrhizal community composition will affect soil carbon sequestration processes in post-agricultural soils. The studies will shed light on the extent to which inoculation with forest-associated mycorrhiza and forest soil will change the soil C input quantity and quality from roots and microbial necromass, eventually enhancing accumulation of persistent forms of SOC. 
 
 We are looking for a candidate with a PhD in the fields of soil science and organic matter studies, soil ecology and biogeochemistry. Previous experience with plant-soil interactions in field, mesocosm and laboratory experiments using chemical soil analyses including soil organic carbon (organic matter fractionation and biomarkers targeting microbial and plant origin of organic matter), carbon isotopes, roots, and microbial taxonomic and functional community composition will be considered a plus.
 
 Principal supervisor is Professor Lars Vesterdal, Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, lv@ign.ku.dk, Phone: +45 61670865
 
 Postdoc 3 – Tree responses to mycorrhiza inoculation
 The postdoc will establish and follow field experiments in practical afforestation sites and monitor plant responses such as growth and survival, mycorrhizal colonization, and plant community development.
 
 The studies will address the potential of inoculation with forest-associated mycorrhiza and forest soil to stimulate survival, growth and carbon draw down of forest trees and communities including the role of tree species and soil type interactions. 
 
 We are looking for highly motivated candidates with a PhD in plant or forestry science and interest and experience in:

   	
• Afforestation, forestry and forest ecology 	
• Design and analysis of experiments 	
• Field work and practical application of technology in land management    
 Principal supervisor is Associate Professor Niclas Scott Bentsen, Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, nb@ign.ku.dk, Phone: +45 20206318.
 
 General qualifications
 Apart from the specific qualifications and interests listed above, we look for candidates with general competences in:

   	
• Driver license (mandatory) 	
• Handling of plants and soil 	
• Organizing and conducting field sampling 	
• Data management 	
• Statistics 	
• Scientific writing and publishing   
 Our groups and research – and what do we offer?
 The positions are located in three different groups at the university.
 
 Postdoc 1 is with Department of Biology, Fungal Ecology lab within Section of Terrestrial Ecology. The group works with/focuses on mycorrhizal fungal communities and their impact on ecosystem processes and plant health. We apply molecular markers to disentangle these otherwise invisible fungal populations and communities associated with plants and soil. Besides molecular markers, we also apply biochemical markers as well as classic microscopy and microbiological culturing of fungi. Another methodological strongpoint is various mesh-enclosure techniques to study and compartmentalize both the function and community composition of mycorrhizal fungal mycelia in soil.
 
 Postdoc 2 and 3 are with Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, one in the Biogeochemistry group and one in the Silviculture, Trees and Bioresources group. In the Biogeochemistry Group we are dedicated to improving the understanding of ecosystem functioning with particular focus on how ecosystems will respond to environmental changes and to management actions. We quantify the pools and fluxes of matter in semi-natural and managed ecosystems and measure the processes related to input and output fluxes in control of soil C stocks to answer questions such as “Can we sequester C in soils by afforestation of cropland soils, and how does this interact with the soil fauna and microbes when using certain tree species or tree species mixtures?” The Silviculture, Trees and Bioresources group encompas expertise in forestry, ecological restoration, growth modelling and systems analysis. The group is dedicated to advance the understanding, development, and management of forest ecosystems to support a wide range of ecosystem services, including carbon storage, material and energy provision, groundwater regulation, and biodiversity conservation.
 
 Department of Biology is located at Norre Campus and Department of Geosciences on Frederiksberg Campus, close to central Copenhagen. The departments offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environments. The departments are planning to increase their focus on the climate change mitigation potential of forests in upcoming projects. We therefore welcome applications from candidates with a broader interest in the intersection of forests, forest-based climate solutions, biosphere-atmosphere interaction, and related themes.
 
 Responsibilities and tasks

   	
• Carry out independent research projects under the PI’s supervision and in close collaboration with the other PostDocs and researchers within the MycoForest project. 	
• Report and disseminate the periodic progress and results 	
• Take part in relevant teaching activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at relevant journals 	
• Actively take part in the research environments at the departments, sections and within the project.   
 We are looking for the following further qualifications:

   	
• Strong ability to interpret data and think analytically, critically, and conceptually. 	
• Strong social competence including interpersonal skills, teamwork and networking ability, and presentation skills 	
• Strong personal competence including autonomy, goal-oriented mind-set, planning/organizing/prioritizing, perseverance, problem-solving skills 	
• General personal leadership skills including ability to translate long-term goals to daily work situations (strategic time managing); be flexible to adjust one’s own behavior and thinking according to the (relevant/local) context so as to attain the desired goals (learning ability) 	
• Good language skills and fluency in English   
 Terms of employment
 Employment is full-time and for 2 years.
 
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.
 
 Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.
 
 Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.
 
 You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).
 
 Application and Assessment Procedure
 Your application including all attachments must be in English and indicate which of the 3 positions you are applying for.
 
 The application is submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.
 
 Please include:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) – please relate how the above required abilities are represented in your past work experiences 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s or master’s and PhD and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Publication list 	
• Reference letters (if available)   
 Application deadline:
 The deadline for applications is 2 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.
 
 We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.
 
 The further process
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.
 
 The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.
 
 Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in week 49-50 2026.
 
 Applicants must be prepared for further security screening related to international research collaborations as part of the recruitment process, when UCPH considers it appropriate from a holistic consideration
 
 Questions
 For specific information about the Postdoc position, please contact the principal supervisor.
